what: The big Hero photo starts as a rounded panel inset 8px from the edges (24px corners), shrinks inward as you scroll to a panel inset 72px (16px corners) (sine.out over the first 8/10), while the photo inside drifts up 150px in the meantime — a Hero where a full-bleed photo retreats into a frame.

options.[data-fx-part=image]: Photo flowing upward inside the panel (optional) — height is 100% + --fx-extra
options.to: Edge inset (px), default 72 — original is screen width ÷ 400 × 20
options.shift: Photo drift (px), default -150 (some sites use -100 on phones)
options.--fx-extra: Added photo length (via style), default 150px — same as |shift|

from.where: index.html .hm-mv (hero photo panel) — original Mv: the mask goes from mv__container size (8px border) · corner 24 to mv__base size (border calc(r×20)) · corner 16 over duration 8 sine.out, photo y −150 (phone −100) duration 10 none, scrub true, start top min(element top, viewport height) · end bottom top
